build_simuleval_parser: build an argparse parser for SimulEval CLI with agent, dataloader, scoring, and device options
add_evaluator_args: add evaluator arguments for quality metrics, latency metrics, remote address, and output directory to a parser
add_dataloader_args: add dataloader arguments to a parser including custom dataloader class registration and argument injection
add_scorer_args: add scorer arguments for latency and quality metrics by resolving scorer classes and calling their add_args methods
add_slurm_args: add slurm cluster arguments for partition, job name, and time limit to an argparse parser
